comment: Material of A-2 (doc/megaliths/A2_CARVED_STELE.md). Generated by tools/blender/megalith_a2_carved_stele.py; the maps are final, the knobs are what made them.
projection: the mesh's own UVs: one atlas for the whole stele

atlas.sides: one strip round the stone, u = 8 px + perimeter metres x 10 (from the front-left corner: front, right, back, left), v = (z + 2 m) x 10; one seam at the front-left corner
atlas.top: own island at (1420, 140) px, x and y in metres x 10

basecolor.what: dark green-black stone, figures a touch lighter, cut lines darker, black scratches, dark runs below the joints, soot toward the foot; no AO in it

normal.convention: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y up), MikkTSpace from the glTF UVs
normal.what: baked from the dense mesh (fine chips, pits, cracks, joint lips) with the bas-relief figures, symbols, scratches and grain laid on (whiteout blend)

ao.what: baked AO of the dense mesh x cut lines x cavities x scratches; multiply it into ambient (in Blender it multiplies the base colour)

roughness.what: matte stone 0.84; relief tops worn smoother, runs smoother, cuts and soot rougher
